title: CoAP v3 compression rules do not gate on NH==UDP (MQTT-SN rule does)
description: compress_global_coap_v3/link_local_v3 validate 5680..5695 ports + UDP checksum but never check ipv6_next_header==IPV6_NH_UDP; compress_mqtt_sn does. TX-side misclassification needs crafted ports+checksum; decompress-side revalidation limits impact. Add NH==UDP to both v3 CoAP rule paths for consistency.
close_reason: compress_global_coap_v3 and compress_link_local_coap_v3 in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_compress.c now gate ipv6_next_header(packet) != IPV6_NH_UDP -> SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE, matching compress_mqtt_sn's pattern (:385). Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra clean; canonical CoAP vectors still accepted - schc_rule1_compress_test (global CoAP path) PASSED and schc_rule5_compress_test (link-local CoAP path) PASSED, run as host CMake ctest on the Mac (Apple clang 21, 100% tests passed); these host suites hardcode -std=c23 which the AWS gcc 11.5 cannot parse, so they are Mac-side by design. Link-side Zephyr builds of the same source pass on AWS (link_crypto build compiles the schc subsystem). Note: schc.c lichen_rule_compress_coap already gated NH at the rule-wrapper level; this fix closes the direct compress_coap entry point.
